messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Re: to calculate genetic map (cM distance between markers) with physical distance in Mbp
parts:
I'm generally not able to provide detailed advice about the course of data analyses.

But it looks you have some markers where the alleles are switched: if your genotypes are coded AA and BB, then there are markers where the AA's should be BB and the BB's should be AA. That can be inferred from the presence of marker pairs where the estimated recombination fraction is near 1 and the LOD score is large. 

Also, since in forming linkage groups you end up with one block that has the vast majority of the markers, it seems you should reduce the max.rf and increase the min.lod in the call to formLinkageGroups.

But if you have a physical map, I don't understand why you would try to construct a linkage map from scratch. The physical map would tell you what chromosomes the markers are on, as well as their order along the chromosome.

karl
